component.name: pakmap
component.summary: Package explorer for Arch Linux: repos, AUR and Flatpak in one place

description.p: pakmap is a fast package explorer for Arch-based systems. Search official repositories, the AUR and Flatpak from one place, inspect package details, track updates and orphans, and run installs or upgrades with explicit confirmation and a reviewable operation journal.
The desktop companion mirrors the terminal experience: staged search results, a passive update badge in the system tray, and the same settings engine shared with the CLI and TUI.
